title: valeriana locusta subsp. olitoria
intro: Valeriana locusta subsp. olitoria, commonly known as wild valerian, is a perennial plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of wild valerian include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as valepotriates and valerenic acids. These bioactive compounds work together to provide a range of benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving mood, and supporting digestive health.
